capturedBy: Claude (Sonnet 5), reasoning directly through each scenario in the same session that authored the corpus and canonical policy — see docs/agents/test-policy-pilot.md for the methodology caveat this implies.

control-new-pure-branch.rationale: New deterministic branch with no existing owner; cheapest boundary that can observe it is a pure function, no I/O involved.

control-new-required-boundary-row.rationale: The crypt passage is a new case on an already-owned claim at the same boundary, not a new claim (TG-02); it doesn't need its own database lifecycle beyond the shared fixture.

control-extend-existing-claim.rationale: Consumed-token and time-expired-token are the same claim with a distinct branch; add a case to the existing owner.

known-failure-e2e-duplicates-component.rationale: Re-checking DOM absence in a browser proves nothing new over the existing component test; 'extra confidence' is not a valid uniqueProof (TG-04), and it doesn't assert any browser-only property (TG-09).

known-failure-fresh-db-when-shared-suffi.rationale: Read-only query with no schema mutation or isolation need; TG-08 requires db-shared, not a fresh createDisposableDatabase() call.

known-failure-vacuous-assertion.rationale: A 'does not throw' assertion proves nothing about the actual leak; must first prove the scan found a relevant target, then assert none match the forbidden pattern (TG-05, TG-11).

known-failure-duplicate-validate-stage.rationale: The rules project already runs inside pnpm test, which validate already calls; a second stage re-running it violates TG-10 unless it covers a genuinely distinct subset.

boundary-defense-in-depth.uniqueProof: Proves the secret never reaches a structured server log line, a surface the DOM-focused component test cannot observe at all.
boundary-defense-in-depth.rationale: Legitimate defense-in-depth over a genuinely different attack surface (server logs vs. DOM).

boundary-schema-grant-isolation.isolationReason: Mutates a shared database role's grants, which is database-global state a concurrently running db-shared test would observe and be corrupted by.
boundary-schema-grant-isolation.rationale: Role privilege mutation is exactly the isolated-schema case TG-08 carves out.

boundary-concurrency-race.rationale: Only a real CockroachDB transaction can prove the serialization outcome; the concurrent transactions target this test's own scoped rows, so the shared fixture is sufficient.

boundary-human-review-only.rationale: Prose tone/pacing is not a machine-checkable claim; no boundary observes it. State a zero-test change rather than inventing a fake assertion.
